name: public_walk
description: This walk opens three pages. You do not need to click anything. At each page, return here and wait for the CAPTURE prompt. Type CAPTURE and press Enter.

stops.name: the_word
stops.label: The capture word
stops.guidance: Opening page one in the browser. Leave the browser open; it closes on its own after capture. When the page has settled, return here and type CAPTURE.

stops.name: the_receipt
stops.label: Page two
stops.guidance: Opening page two in the browser. Leave the browser open; it closes on its own after capture. When the page has settled, return here and type CAPTURE.

stops.name: the_two_pages
stops.label: Two versions of one page
stops.guidance: Opening the last page in the browser. Leave the browser open; it closes on its own after capture. When the page has settled, return here, type CAPTURE, and read the result.
